items.title: Hims & Hers stock climbs on direct partnership with Eli Lilly for obesity drugs
items.summary: Investing.com -- Shares of Hims & Hers Health Inc (NYSE:HIMS) rose 6.3% on Friday following an agreement with Eli Lilly and Company (NYSE:LLY) to sell its weight-loss treatments directly through the telehealth provider's platform. The partnership eliminates a previous friction point for patients, who previously had to navigate away from Hims & Hers to Lilly’s standalone cash-pay portal, LillyDirect, to access the drugmaker's branded therapies.
